meta_title: Audiobook Tracker for iPhone: Log Listening Time | BookWorm
meta_desc: Track audiobooks in hours and minutes next to your paper books and ebooks, with one daily goal, a reading timer and Lock Screen widgets. For iPhone and iPad.
og_title: An audiobook tracker that counts listening as reading
og_desc: Hours and minutes, a Lock Screen timer, and one daily goal for audiobooks, ebooks and paper.
h1: Listening is reading. Track it like it.
lede: BookWorm keeps your audiobooks on the same shelf as your paper books, tracked in hours and minutes, counted toward the same daily goal and the same streak.
shot_alt: The BookWorm reading timer running for Shoe Dog by Phil Knight.
shot2_alt: A book's page in BookWorm with progress, Continue Reading and Update Progress.
points_lede: Most reading trackers only understand pages. BookWorm understands where you are in a listen.
p1_d: Log 3 h 30 m of 11 h 35 m and the progress bar, the calendar and your stats all speak in time.
p2_d: Set your daily goal in minutes or pages. Listening and reading both count toward it, so a commute with an audiobook keeps the streak alive.
p3_d: Start a session when you press play. Pause and resume it from the Lock Screen or the Dynamic Island, then log where you got to.
p4_d: BookWorm's sounds never pause or quieten your audiobook, and the Silent switch silences them completely.
deep_p1: Search by title or author and the cover fills itself in. Choose audiobook, and BookWorm suggests a length from the book's page count, which you can change to match your edition.
deep_p2: Switch a book between paper, ebook and audio whenever you like. Each day keeps the format it was read in, so your history stays accurate.
deep_link: Read the guide to tracking audiobooks
q1: Does listening to an audiobook count toward my reading goal?
a1: Yes. BookWorm counts minutes listened and pages read toward the same daily goal, so every format keeps your streak going.
q2: Can I track an audiobook and a paper book at the same time?
a2: Yes. Every book you're reading sits on Home, whatever its format, and you update each one on its own.
q3: How does BookWorm know how long an audiobook is?
a3: When you add one from search, it estimates the length from the book's page count. You can type the exact length from your audiobook app instead.
q4: Does BookWorm play or download audiobooks?
a4: No. Keep listening in the app you already use. BookWorm is where you keep track of it.
